title: Where and when: postpositions
summary: Use the postpositions by the case they take: *bilen*, *üçin*, *ýaly*, *barada*, *hakda* with a noun as it is (*seniň hakda* with a pronoun), *çenli*, *görä*, *tarap*, *garşy*, *ýakyn* with the dative (*maňa görä*, *öýe tarap*), *soň*, *öň*, *bäri*, *başga* with the ablative (*2020-nji ýyldan bäri*), and say where things are with place nouns (*stoluň üstünde*, *öýüň öňünde*, *ýatagyň aşagyndan*).
canDo: Say where things and people are: on, under, in, next to, in front of, behind, between
Say where to put things and where they come out of
Say what something is about, and give your opinion with Maňa görä
Say how long something has gone on with bäri, and what comes before or after
